As Alex, I approach this allocation by methodically weighing the temporal scope and nature of the impact for each option. 

Option 2 (immediate flood-relief supplies) addresses an acute, present crisis, focusing on the urgent preservation of current lives and immediate community stability. 
Option 1 (long-term pandemic-preparedness research) focuses on proactive preservation, mitigating future systemic risks, and ensuring the long-term continuity of society, infrastructure, and the historical record itself.

Given my professional inclination as an archivist toward long-term preservation, systemic resilience, and safeguarding the future, I will direct the funds toward the proactive, long-term measure.
